proposer.scenario: when a multi-step manipulation plan is underway and the next concrete action is already determined
proposer.experience: emit the executable action immediately instead of inserting deliberation steps, since each 'think' step consumes the step budget without changing the world and can cause the plan to run out of steps before completion.
